build_sauter_model_config: build a SauterModelConfig instance with a bootstrap_multiplier for the Sauter bootstrap current model
build_sauter_model: build a SauterModel instance from a SauterModelConfig to calculate bootstrap current
calculate_bootstrap_current: calculate bootstrap current using the SauterModel with runtime params, geometry, and core profiles
